name: weft-loom
description: Weft Loom is a free desktop app for pattern music, built on Strudel.
readme_summary: Weft Loom is a free, open-source desktop application for creating pattern-based music using Strudel. It offers a visual interface with step grids and piano rolls that directly correspond to and can rewrite the underlying Strudel code, allowing users to create music without extensive coding or to easily modify existing code.
key_features: Visual music creation with step grids and piano rolls linked to Strudel code
Sound browser for selecting, recording, and importing sounds
Song panel for arranging patterns and creating variations
Live performance features with keyboard input
Integrated mixer with volume, pan, tone, and limiter
Multiple export options (sound file, individual patterns, code, .weft file)
Collaborative jamming with real-time synchronization and communication
Publishing songs to a public site for sharing and remixing
primary_use_case: Creating and performing algorithmic music through a visual interface that is directly linked to code.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, magical loom weaving intricate patterns of light and sound. Instead of threads, the loom uses glowing streams of musical notes and code snippets. A friendly artisan, representing the user, gently guides the loom, transforming raw musical ideas (represented by scattered musical notes) into a structured, harmonious melody (represented by a beautifully woven tapestry of light). Subtle UI elements like knobs and sliders are integrated into the loom's design, and small, stylized code blocks float around the scene. The overall mood is creative and accessible, with a clean, vibrant color palette. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a touch of fantasy.

name: De-Nox
readme_summary: De-Nox is a Rust-based terminal disk-cleanup tool that intelligently identifies and removes dormant build artifacts like `node_modules` and `target`. It differentiates between truly abandoned projects and active ones by analyzing the last modification date of the project's source files, not just the artifact directories themselves.
key_features: Intelligent disk cleanup based on project activity, not just artifact age
Terminal-based TUI using ratatui
Read-only until explicit deletion confirmation
Fast scanning by avoiding deep dives into artifact directories
Configurable project idle threshold
Detailed reporting of candidates and reclaimed space
primary_use_case: Cleaning up disk space occupied by build artifacts and dependencies of inactive software projects without accidentally deleting files from active projects.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old gardener carefully tending to a sprawling digital garden. Instead of weeds, the garden is overgrown with tangled, dusty 'node_modules' and 'target' folders. The gardener uses a special magnifying glass (representing De-Nox) to examine the 'soil' (project source files) around each overgrown patch. Patches belonging to healthy, actively growing plants (active projects) are left untouched, while patches around withered, dormant plants (inactive projects) are clearly marked for gentle pruning. The gardener's pruning shears are poised, ready to remove only the clearly marked, unnecessary growth, freeing up space for new seeds to be planted. The scene is rendered in a warm, inviting 3D isometric illustration style with subtle glowing data particles.

name: soundwaves
description: A sound waves simulator 2D + planar & axis symmetry
readme_summary: SoundWaves is a 2D sound wave simulator that runs in the browser, allowing users to draw scenes, define materials, and simulate wave propagation. It supports both planar and axisymmetric modes, with waves solved using finite elements in Rust compiled to WebAssembly.
key_features: 2D sound wave simulation
Browser-based interface
Scene drawing and material definition
Planar and axisymmetric modes
Finite element method (FEM) simulation
Rust to WebAssembly compilation
Text-based scene definition
Dockable panels for interface customization
primary_use_case: Simulating and visualizing sound wave propagation in 2D environments for acoustic analysis and design.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, magical conductor standing in a minimalist concert hall, holding a glowing baton. As the baton moves, visible sound waves ripple outwards from it, interacting with abstract, drawn shapes representing walls and objects in the hall. Some waves are absorbed by textured surfaces, others reflect. Small, ethereal UI elements showing wave patterns and frequency graphs float subtly around the conductor. The scene is bathed in a soft, ethereal light, emphasizing the visual representation of sound. The overall style is a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear visual metaphor and vibrant, yet harmonious colors, with the repository name 'SoundWaves' subtly etched on a nearby music stand.

name: innovation-lab-examples
description: 80+ production-ready AI agent examples in Python — build autonomous agents, multi-agent systems and agentic AI with uAgents, ASI:One, MCP, A2A, LangChain, CrewAI, Gemini, Claude and OpenAI.
readme_summary: This repository provides over 80 production-ready Python examples for building autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, and agentic AI workflows. It supports various frameworks and tools like uAgents, LangChain, CrewAI, and major LLMs, catering to beginners and experienced developers alike.
key_features: 80+ production-ready AI agent examples
Support for autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, and agentic AI
Integration with uAgents, ASI:One, Agentverse, LangChain, CrewAI, Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI
Python-based with Python 3.10+ compatibility
Self-contained, runnable projects with individual READMEs and dependencies
Quickstart guides and automated setup scripts
Docker support
primary_use_case: To serve as a comprehensive resource and starting point for developers looking to build and experiment with AI agents and multi-agent systems using Python and various popular AI frameworks.
cover_image_prompt: A bustling digital marketplace where diverse AI agents, represented as stylized robotic figures with glowing data streams, are autonomously exchanging information and services. One agent, a wise owl-like automaton, is shown receiving a complex query (represented by a swirling vortex of data) and then efficiently distributing tasks to specialized agents (a swift courier bot, a meticulous analyst bot, a creative artist bot). The background features subtle UI elements displaying transaction logs and agent communication networks. The overall scene is vibrant and futuristic, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a clean, organized composition and a color palette of blues, purples, and glowing oranges, symbolizing intelligent collaboration and efficient automation.

name: SoulX-Podcast
description: SoulX-Podcast is an inference codebase by the Soul AI team for generating high-fidelity podcasts from text.
readme_summary: SoulX-Podcast is a Python-based inference codebase for generating high-fidelity, long-form podcasts from text. It supports multi-turn, multi-speaker dialogic speech generation, cross-dialectal voice cloning, and paralinguistic controls for enhanced realism.
key_features: Long-form, multi-turn, multi-speaker dialogic speech generation
Cross-dialectal, zero-shot voice cloning
Paralinguistic controls (e.g., laughter, sighs)
Support for Mandarin, English, and several Chinese dialects (Sichuanese, Henanese, Cantonese)
primary_use_case: Generating realistic, diverse, and personalized long-form podcast-style audio from text, including multi-speaker dialogues and various paralinguistic expressions.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled radio host in a cozy, sound-proofed studio, holding a microphone and speaking into it. From the microphone, streams of diverse audio waves emanate, transforming into distinct characters' voices and speech bubbles representing different dialects (Mandarin, Sichuanese, Cantonese) and emotions (laughter, sighs). A subtle digital interface on a nearby screen displays the text input and the generated audio waveforms. The scene is illuminated by warm studio lights, with the 'SoulX-Podcast' logo subtly integrated into the studio's branding. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, inviting aesthetic, emphasizing the transformation of text into rich, varied human speech.
